cause: Pre-existing fork defect (backlog B11), fork commit f1b7aebff8c2 '[LLVM/PULP/SNITCH] Support for PULP and Snitch cores/platforms': label operand uimm12pcrel used the constant-only parser class UImmAsmOperand<12> with no Match_InvalidUImm12 diagnostic (-> 'Unknown match type detected!' crash); R001 copied the pattern to uimm5pcrel (-> lp.setupi label rejected as [0,31]).
fix: insn-tablegen: uimm12pcrel/uimm5pcrel ParserMatchClass -> UImmAsmOperand<12/5,"PCRel"> (bare symbol or constant, like upstream simm13_lsb0/SImmAsmOperand<13,"Lsb0"> RISCVInstrInfo.td:271 @llvmorg-20.1.8); loop-count operand of LOOP{0,1}setupi and LOOP{0,1}counti -> fork uimm12 (was the label operand; count is a plain number; same field/decoder, getImmOpValue returns constants unchanged). mc: RISCVAsmParser isUImm5PCRel/isUImm12PCRel (shape of upstream isBareSimmNLsb0, RISCVAsmParser.cpp:523) + diagnostics for InvalidUImm12/UImm5PCRel/UImm12PCRel; RISCVAsmBackend: range + 2-byte-alignment check on fixup_pulpv2_loop_setup(i), same as upstream fixup_riscv_branch (RISCVAsmBackend.cpp:461).
prev_attempt_review: Previous attempt diff saved to logs/20-F010.prev-attempt.diff. Parser and .td hunks kept as-is. RISCVAsmBackend.cpp hunk was dropped, then restored (comment reworded) after demonstrating it is necessary: applyFixup does not mask, so an out-of-range hand-written label silently corrupts the adjacent field (lp.setupi x0, 100, .Lfar at +104 bytes assembled to 'lp.setupi x0, 0x65, 0x14', i.e. count 100->101); GNU as rejects it (BFD_RELOC_RISCV_RELU5 Overflow). Accepted limits match GNU as exactly (62 B setupi / 8190 B setup accepted byte-identical, 64 / 8192 rejected by both). Return value (Value>>1) unchanged, so no in-range encoding changes; compiler path objects are byte-identical to int-20 (sweep + fuzzer + C loops).

other_errors_seen: GNU as vs LLVM numeric-operand semantics differ (pre-existing, not changed): GNU as treats a numeric lp.setup/lp.setupi/lp.starti/lp.endi label operand as a BYTE offset ('lp.setup x0,a0,20' -> field 10), LLVM as the raw halfword field value (field 20, and llvm-objdump prints the raw field so it round-trips). Changing this would change existing LLVM behaviour; owner decision.

GNU as keeps R_RISCV_REL12/R_RISCV_RELU5 relocations for hardware-loop labels (for linker relaxation); LLVM resolves them in the assembler and emits none (pre-existing, same for the compiler path). ld.lld cannot link GNU-as objects that contain these (unknown relocation 58).
Pre-existing: 'scfgri a0, 5000' (Xssr, uimm12) crashed llvm-mc with 'Unknown match type detected!' for the same missing InvalidUImm12 diagnostic; now a normal range error (side effect of this fix).
The insn-tablegen fixup commit alone does not compile (the generated matcher needs isUImm12PCRel from the mc fixup); both must land together (cluster order puts insn-tablegen before mc in the stack).
